opportunities.mechanic: Audacious Charge has 1.2 AP magic damage, W thrust adds 0.65 AP physical damage and longer slow, and Crescent Guard has 1.1 AP physical damage. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn support attacks between Q cooldown refunds; Determination's AP healing helpers suggest sustain but exact dispatch remains unresolved.
opportunities.requiredState: Mark with W, enter E and complete real Q attacks.
opportunities.failure: Low AD or attacks interrupted by control lose both damage and refunds.
opportunities.test: Separate E magic, W/R physical and passive healing in a ten-second duel.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP ratios do not turn W/R magic; no verified numeric healing from unresolved conditional helpers.

opportunities.name: Crescent health frontline
opportunities.objective: Test crescent health frontline against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Crescent Guard excludes damage from enemies outside its sweep range for four seconds; health and Bloodmail support surviving the challenged inside opponent. Three Talon Strike lowers other cooldowns on its three actual attacks, while Visage and Sundered Sky help the repeat-contact phase.
opportunities.requiredState: Choose a favorable challenged enemy and keep outside threats beyond R's radius.
opportunities.failure: The challenged melee opponent still deals damage and crowd control can prevent Q hits.
opportunities.test: Compare inside versus outside incoming damage and Q refund count.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Crescent Guard is not complete invulnerability and does not excuse ignoring the duel target.

ruledOut.reason: AP ratios do not turn W/R magic; no verified numeric healing from unresolved conditional helpers.

opportunities.name: Mist magic siege
opportunities.objective: Test mist magic siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Mourning Mist adds 0.03 AP percentage-point scaling to its target-max-health magic damage; Liandry supports that spell burn while Maiden's magic attack and marked-target followup supply a second magic pressure source. AP does not scale Mist Walker AD, so pet damage must be compared honestly.
opportunities.requiredState: Maiden alive, E lands and enemy remains near owner followup attacks.
opportunities.failure: Weak Q/ghoul physical damage and pet clearing can erase the siege.
opportunities.test: Measure E, Maiden and owner mark-followup damage separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP does not grant ghouls AP attack scaling or owner item on-hit inheritance.

opportunities.name: Grave health spell bruiser
opportunities.objective: Test grave health spell bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Mist Walker and Maiden helper health scale from source owner health, while their damage uses AD[source modifier]; Bloodmail therefore tests health-to-AD pet durability and damage together. Sundered Sky rewards Yorick's own Q attack and Visage supports its missing-health heal, with E providing current armor reduction.
opportunities.requiredState: Raise real graves and preserve Maiden before committing.
opportunities.failure: Pet clearing and weak personal mobility prevent meaningful pressure.
opportunities.test: Compare pet health/damage with measured owner health and AD, plus Q healing.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Pet helper stats require source mapping; Maiden is not assumed to proc Sundered Sky.

ruledOut.reason: AP does not grant ghouls AP attack scaling or owner item on-hit inheritance.

opportunities.name: Determination health drain
opportunities.objective: Test determination health drain against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: The Darkin Glaive heals 5-9% max health on its first attack; Bloodmail adds AD from purchased health and Visage supports that heal plus Grim Deliverance's damage-based healing. Repeated W/E/Q contacts build twelve Determination stacks before the conditional revive, but exact passive AD values are unresolved.
opportunities.requiredState: Reach twelve real stacks before lethal damage with revive available.
opportunities.failure: Burst before full stacks or healing reduction removes the safety net.
opportunities.test: Measure Q healing and time to twelve stacks against a mobile target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Revive is not always active and its unresolved health fraction cannot be invented.

opportunities.name: Glaive attack weave
opportunities.objective: Test glaive attack weave against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: The Darkin Glaive's first empowered attack slashes twice and its recast knocks up; Trinity adds one physical Spellblade while Blade and Terminus test personal attack pressure. Hexplate supports attacks after R, with edge E providing a mixed physical and max-health magic packet.
opportunities.requiredState: Land Q attacks between E spacing and use R before the attack-speed window.
opportunities.failure: Less raw AD weakens the 2.0 AD[source modifier] ultimate burst.
opportunities.test: Compare Q attack packets and stack gain with item effects logged separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Two slashes do not prove double full on-hits or two automatic Determination stacks.

ruledOut.reason: Revive is not always active and its unresolved health fraction cannot be invented.

opportunities.name: Laser hybrid artillery
opportunities.objective: Test laser hybrid artillery against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Ultrashock Laser has 0.5 AP and total-AD physical damage and terrain hits force its special crit; R adds 1.1 AP magic damage while E adds AP-scaled magic on-hit. Gunblade retains AD and earned Muramana supports physical spell poke, with Serylda matching physical W rather than R.
opportunities.requiredState: Find safe terrain laser angles and save E for repositioning.
opportunities.failure: Weak ordinary Q attack scaling and reduced sustained crit lose extended fights.
opportunities.test: Measure terrain W physical damage separately from R/E magic packets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Legacy Q missiles contain AP terms, but primary Q has no AP term; do not promote helpers to live damage.

opportunities.name: Burst Fire health bruiser
opportunities.objective: Test burst fire health bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Burst Fire is explicitly treated as an attack and scales 1.02-1.1 total AD; Bloodmail and Titanic test health-backed physical Q attacks while Cleaver supports shred. Hexplate synchronizes with R's speed window, but item trigger effectiveness must be checked on the whole Q burst.
opportunities.requiredState: Hit moving Q bursts and maintain R through champion contact.
opportunities.failure: Low crit loses extra Overcharge stacks and E cooldown refunds.
opportunities.test: Count Q item packets, E refunds and R uptime during a moving ten-second chase.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Seven Q rounds are not seven full independent item on-hits, and passive attacks are treated as abilities.

ruledOut.reason: Legacy Q missiles contain AP terms, but primary Q has no AP term; do not promote helpers to live damage.

opportunities.name: Sparkles attack jump
opportunities.objective: Test sparkles attack jump against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: More Sparkles adds 0.2 AP magic damage after each cast; Portal Jump grants one second to attack before forced return. Nashor and Lich Bane test that safe-looking attack window with a second spell to refresh passive, while bubble controls the target and Terminus fits mixed normal attacks.
opportunities.requiredState: Land E and choose an R destination with safe return position.
opportunities.failure: One-second immobility and fixed return can expose Zoe; low spell burst loses picks.
opportunities.test: Compare R-window attacks and incoming damage against a long-distance Q.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The passive is refreshed by casts, not permanently added to every attack during R.

opportunities.name: Bubble repeat control siege
opportunities.objective: Test bubble repeat control siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Sleepy Trouble Bubble refunds 16-30% of its cooldown when bubble/trap hits a champion; terrain extends reach and sleep reduces MR for two seconds. opportunities.requiredState: Hit E through terrain then deliver one well-timed long Q.
opportunities.failure: Burn or allied damage might wake early; trap misses provide no refund.
opportunities.test: Record E cooldown and first wake packet with and without burns.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Sleep bonus has a damage cap and cannot double every damage-over-time tick.
